description: Declared case list for ticket 14's private tracer-bullet scenario (cbrd_26659_oos_dur01, revision 8). Tooling input only: the testcase repository does not depend on it. The expected assertion counts per build and the activation markers come from evidence/ticket14/expected-oracle.md section 5 and the case's own evidence files.

services.identity: started and crashed by the case; port 26659
t26659dur01, created, crashed, restarted and dropped by the case
cub_pl for t26659dur01, started by the server and killed with it

cbrd_26659_oos_dur01.assertion_count_derivation: expected-oracle.md section 5: 18 assertions, #18 skips on a release build

applicability.fixture: Identical, because it is the same run: the four rows of (id INT, v BIT VARYING) at 4,036 / 16,284 / 4,011 / 4,036 bytes that the assertions judge are the rows SHOW HEAP OOS counted and whose log records recovery replayed, in a database the case created, owns exclusively and drops.
applicability.execution_path: Identical: every observation was taken in the same CTP invocation against the same client-server server process. Two channels under `other`: SHOW HEAP OOS after the committed INSERT and after the restart (insert-side demotion and the chains' presence after recovery), and the server's own recovery log (exactly one new REDO phase with at least one record to redo), which is what shows the recovery path ran. Neither certifies a vacuum or reclaim path.
applicability.engine_configuration: Pinned engine commit f4299ac0cd777a2a964c1f197ae5ebf9841a4936, unmodified install of the build under test, 16 KiB pages read back from spacedb, async_commit=n and group_commit_interval_in_msecs=0 read back from paramdump.
applicability.conditions: Single session, no concurrency, no fault injection, empty table at the start, one deliberate kill -9 between the two SHOW HEAP OOS observations; exclusive ownership of the table and the database attributes the chunk count and the replayed records to this workload.

databases: t26659dur01, created by the case with --db-page-size=16384 under the case directory of the campaign testcase worktree, and dropped by it
processes: cub_master started by the case's `cubrid server start` and killed with kill -9
cub_server t26659dur01, killed with kill -9 and restarted
cub_pl t26659dur01, killed with the server
